overall_reason: Untinted greys with a near-black #1f1f1f 'Deploy' button carry the card, and small green, grey and red icons mark live, building and failed rows.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES passes with one ground and state colours in one role each; T-GRAYSCALE passes because each state icon has its own shape; T-NEUTRALS finds two near-identical meta greys.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.evidence: The text roles list #9a9a9a on 3 elements and #8a8a8a on 1, about 0.05 apart in lightness, for secondary text of one kind.
findings.before: Two secondary greys one small step apart.
findings.after: One secondary grey for all row metadata.
findings.why: Two nearly equal greys look like an accident rather than two levels.

strengths: State colours are held to the icons and keep their meaning.
One near-black primary and no other fill in the card.
